title: Telangana Regulator Rejects Plea to Cut PM KUSUM Solar Tariff to ₹2.98/kWh
summary: The Telangana Electricity Regulatory Commission (TGERC) has rejected distribution companies’ (DISCOMs) proposal to reduce the ₹3.13 (~$0.033)/kWh pre-fixed levelized tariff for solar projects under Component-A of the PM-KUSUM program to ₹2.98 (~$0.031)/kWh following a reduction in goods and services tax (GST).

score_reasons: -3 Passing mention without a quantified development
direction_reasons: TARIFF cuts both ways — growth against capital, cost or execution risk
watch_next: competitor exposure to the same duty
WAAREEENER.why_it_matters: This is industry-level news rather than company news via its industry exposure to solar tariff. The parts of the business most likely touched are exports, pricing, regulation. Classified as tariff.
